2026_008_10_april_2026_check_register.paragraph: Troy School District's check register for accounting period 10 of fiscal 2026, produced on the Pentamation Enterprises ACCTPA21 report dated 06/04/2026 and carried on the Board of Education agenda for June 16, 2026, lists disbursements fund by fund across 37 pages. Checks numbered 2603009 through 2603274 were issued 04/13/26 and 04/23/26, supplemented by wire and ACH payments W26-198 through W26-255. The printed report total is $35,038,163.95, a figure driven by semiannual bond principal and interest paid 04/21/26 -- the 2023 Debt Service Fund alone accounts for $14,645,843.75 -- while the General Fund totals $4,631,698.64.
